```{r Variance partirioning, include=FALSE}
############################################################
# VARIANCE PARTITIONING OF PHENOTYPIC VARIATION
#
# Objective:
# Quantify the unique and shared contributions of genetic,
# epigenetic and environmental variation to phenotypic
# variation.
#
# Rationale:
# MMRR identifies associations between distance matrices,
# but when predictor matrices are highly correlated
# (e.g. genetic and epigenetic distances), regression
# coefficients can become difficult to interpret.
#
# Variance partitioning provides complementary information
# by decomposing the explained phenotypic variation into:
#
# - Unique genetic component
# - Unique epigenetic component
# - Unique environmental component
# - Shared fractions among predictors
#
# Because capscale()/varpart() require explanatory variables
# rather than distance matrices, each predictor distance
# matrix is first represented by a small number of PCoA axes.
############################################################

library(vegan)

############################################################
# 1. PRINCIPAL COORDINATE ANALYSIS (PCoA)
############################################################
# Función para procesar cada especie
procesar_especie <- function(phenoDIST, genDIST, epiDIST, envDIST, especie_nombre) {
  
  # Genetic distances
  gen_pcoa <- cmdscale(genDIST,
    eig = TRUE,
    k = 10
  )
  
  # Epigenetic distances
  epi_pcoa <- cmdscale(epiDIST,
    eig = TRUE,
    k = 10
  )
  
  # Environmental distances
  env_pcoa <- cmdscale(envDIST,
    eig = TRUE,
    k = 10
  )
  
  ############################################################
  # 2. EXAMINE EIGENVALUES
  ############################################################
  
  # Proportion of variance explained by each axis
  
  gen_var <- gen_pcoa$eig / sum(gen_pcoa$eig[gen_pcoa$eig > 0])
  epi_var <- epi_pcoa$eig / sum(epi_pcoa$eig[epi_pcoa$eig > 0])
  env_var <- env_pcoa$eig / sum(env_pcoa$eig[env_pcoa$eig > 0])
  
  cat("\n", especie_nombre, "- Cumulative variance:\n")
  cat("Genetic:\n")
  print(cumsum(gen_var))
  cat("Epigenetic:\n")
  print(cumsum(epi_var))
  cat("Environmental:\n")
  print(cumsum(env_var))
  
  ############################################################
  # 3. RETAIN LEADING AXES
  ############################################################
  
  # The number of axes can be adjusted after inspecting
  # cumulative explained variance above.
  #
  # With n = 40 individuals, retaining a small number
  # of axes helps avoid overfitting.
  
  GEN <- as.data.frame(gen_pcoa$points[, 1:8])
  EPI <- as.data.frame(epi_pcoa$points[, 1:8])
  ENV <- as.data.frame(env_pcoa$points[, 1:2])
  
  ############################################################
  # 4. VARIANCE PARTITIONING
  ############################################################
  
  vp <- varpart(
    phenoDIST,
    GEN,
    EPI,
    ENV
  )
  
  return(vp)
}

# Ejecutar para ambas especies
vp_plantago <- procesar_especie(p.phenoDIST, p.genDIST, p.epiDIST, p.envDIST, "Plantago")
vp_avena <- procesar_especie(a.phenoDIST, a.genDIST, a.epiDIST, a.envDIST, "Avena")
```

```{r Figura, echo=FALSE, results='hold', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

############################################################
# VARIANCE PARTITIONING VENN DIAGRAMS
# P. lagopus and A. barbata
############################################################

library(ggplot2)
library(ggforce)
library(cowplot)

############################################################
# EXTRAER FRACCIONES DE VARPART
############################################################

extract_varpart <- function(vp){

  vals <- vp$part$indfract$Adj.R.square

  return(vals)
}

############################################################
# No contar valores negativos
############################################################

add_label <- function(value, x, y, bold = FALSE, prefix = "") {

  if (value < 0) return(NULL)

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = x,
    y = y,
    label = paste0(prefix, sprintf("%.3f", value)),
    size = 5,
    fontface = ifelse(bold, "bold", "plain")
  )
}

############################################################
# DIBUJAR PANEL
############################################################

make_venn_panel <- function(frac, title){

  labs_frac <- sprintf("%.3f", frac)

  ggplot() +

    ########################################################
    # CIRCULOS
    ########################################################

    geom_circle(
      aes(x0 = 3.0, y0 = 5.0, r = 1.7),
      fill = "#4C72B0",
      alpha = 0.35,
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +

    geom_circle(
      aes(x0 = 5.0, y0 = 5.0, r = 1.7),
      fill = "#DD8452",
      alpha = 0.35,
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +

    geom_circle(
      aes(x0 = 4.0, y0 = 3.4, r = 1.7),
      fill = "#55A868",
      alpha = 0.35,
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +

    ########################################################
    # FRACCIONES
    ########################################################

    add_label(frac[1], 2.1, 5.2) +  # Genetic unique
  add_label(frac[2], 5.9, 5.2) +  # Epigenetic unique
  add_label(frac[3], 4.0, 2.1) +  # Environmental unique
  add_label(frac[4], 4.0, 5.5) +  # Genetic + Epigenetic
  add_label(frac[5], 5.0, 3.9) +  # Epigenetic + Environmental
  add_label(frac[6], 3.0, 3.9) +  # Genetic + Environmental
  add_label(frac[7], 4.0, 4.5, bold = TRUE) +  # Triple overlap
  add_label(frac[8], 5.3, 0.5, prefix = "Residuals: ") +

    ########################################################
    # PANEL
    ########################################################

    coord_fixed() +

    xlim(1.1, 7.1) +
    ylim(0.5, 7.0) +

    labs(title = title) +

    theme_void(base_size = 14) +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "italic",
        size = 14
      ),

      panel.border = element_rect(
        colour = "black",
        fill = NA,
        linewidth = 0.9
      )
    )
}

############################################################
# EXTRAER RESULTADOS
############################################################

frac_plantago <- extract_varpart(vp_plantago)
frac_avena    <- extract_varpart(vp_avena)

############################################################
# CREAR PANELES
############################################################

p1 <- make_venn_panel(
  frac_plantago,
  "P. lagopus"
)

p2 <- make_venn_panel(
  frac_avena,
  "A. barbata"
)

############################################################
# LEYENDA
############################################################

legend_df <- data.frame(
  Variable = c(
    "Genetic",
    "Epigenetic",
    "Environmental"
  ),
  x = 1,
  y = c(3,2,1)
)

legend_plot <- ggplot(
  legend_df,
  aes(x, y, colour = Variable)
) +

  geom_point(size = 6) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      Genetic      = "#4C72B0",
      Epigenetic   = "#DD8452",
      Environmental= "#55A868"
    )
  ) +

  theme_void() +

  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )

legend <- get_legend(legend_plot)

############################################################
# FIGURA FINAL
############################################################

final_plot <- plot_grid(
  p1,
  p2,
  legend,
  nrow = 1,
  rel_widths = c(1, 1, 0.35)
)

print(final_plot)

############################################################
# EXPORTAR
############################################################

ggsave(
  "variance_partitioning_venn.pdf",
  final_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 5
)

ggsave(
  "variance_partitioning_venn.png",
  final_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)

```
